meta.unit: All lengths are iOS points (pt) at 1x on a 393 x 852 canvas. Figma frames were 1074px wide and were divided by 2.754 (1074 / 390), then snapped to the 4pt grid.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Cash out button), selected tab tint. Merges Figma #1464FF and #1364FF. White text on it is 4.89:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue-500, green-700 and navy-900. Replaces the off-whites #F2F2F2, #F9F8F4 and #F2EDFF used on colored fills.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Reward surface that carries text (AmountHero earned state, History pill, info icon tile). White on it is 5.33:1. Replaces #0C9971 wherever small text sits on green.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: The brand green, used only as the end stop of reward-gradient and in illustration. Never put text under 24pt on it (white is 3.61:1).

tokens.name: lime-400
tokens.usage: Decorative sparkle in reward illustrations only. Never a text background: white on it is 1.72:1.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Inverse card for waiting and pending states (Countdown card). The Figma annotation asked for #000748; it also replaces #20262D.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: Top of the mission gradient (MissionCard header, Congrats card). White text on it is 4.6:1; keep text 17pt bold or larger.

tokens.name: indigo-800
tokens.usage: Bottom of the mission gradient. White text on it is 11.9:1.

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Coin amounts and the mission timer on dark or violet surfaces. Never on white.

tokens.name: mint-400
tokens.usage: Claim buttons (with lime, as a gradient) and done states. Text on it is dark green #0B2A12, never white.

tokens.name: sky-200
tokens.usage: Coin cell at the start of a MissionRow. Text on it is near-black.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-grouped and surface-info. Replaces #20262D and #0A0A0A body text.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, row metadata, inactive tab labels. Replaces #848589, which failed contrast (3.69:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Plain (text-only) buttons such as Keep playing and See all. Dark value lifted so it reads 5.75:1 on the dark surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheet and screen background.

tokens.name: surface-grouped
tokens.usage: Grouped list background, stat tiles, game cards. Merges #F2F2F2 and #F5F8FA.

tokens.name: surface-info
tokens.usage: Background of InfoRow, the notice explaining when coins convert.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline row separators inside HistoryList; 0.5pt on device.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status text (Paid) in HistoryList. 4.9:1 on surface-grouped light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and limit messages, 5.98:1 on danger-surface. Replaces pure red at 60% opacity, which was 2.86:1.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Background of InlineMessage in the danger tone.

tokens.name: grabber
tokens.usage: Sheet drag indicator. On device use the system indicator (.presentationDragIndicator(.visible)) instead.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming behind a presented sheet. On device the system sheet supplies it.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: The balance in AmountHero. Scales with Dynamic Type relative to .largeTitle; use monospaced digits so the number does not jump while counting up. Replaces Figtree ExtraBold 150px / 57px leading.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles in a navigation bar (.largeTitle).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Button labels and list row titles (.headline).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Earned and ready to cash out.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Eyebrow above the amount in AmountHero (.callout).

styles.name: subheadline
styles.sample: Your stars turn into rewards in 3h 45m.
styles.usage: InfoRow text and AmountHero subtitle (.subheadline). Bold the duration with the semibold weight, not a second font.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: StatTile labels and the History pill label (.caption).

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab bar item labels, matching the system tab bar.

spacing.note: A 4pt grid. Screen margin is space-4 (16pt); Figma used 8, 9.4 and 6.5pt margins on the same sheet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside the History pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its subtitle; stack spacing inside StatTile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: InfoRow icon-to-text gap; gap between game cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin (matches the system readable margin on iPhone), card padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside AmountHero.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sheet sections (hero, notice, actions).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above the primary action group.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding above an empty-state illustration.

radius.note: Draw every radius with continuous corners on device (RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius:style: .continuous)). Figma had 13 different radii, including 19.794px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Game thumbnails, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, InlineMessage, list rows in an inset group.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: InfoRow, game cards, HistoryList inset group.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: AmountHero card. Replaces 75px@3x (27pt) and 50pt.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the History pill, any capsule. On device use Capsule().

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of a large filled Button (.controlSize(.large)). Figma had 67pt.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable area for any control, including plain buttons and the History pill.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Visible height of the History pill; pad its hit area to hit-target.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: The circular icon tile at the start of InfoRow.

tokens.name: tab-bar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar height above the home-indicator safe area (system value).

shadow.note: One elevation. iOS buttons are flat: the 0 4 2 rgba(0,0,0,.3) button shadow from Figma is removed.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards on the home feed only. Cards inside a sheet get no shadow.

duration.note: Animation durations. In SwiftUI prefer the named springs; these are their web equivalents.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback on buttons and pills. SwiftUI: .snappy(duration: 0.15).

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Fades, digit roll on the countdown, content rising in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet presentation, success pop.

tokens.name: duration-count
tokens.usage: Balance count-up after a cash out.

easing.note: Curves that approximate SwiftUI's springs on the web.

tokens.name: easing-snappy
tokens.usage: SwiftUI .snappy. Presses, digit changes.

tokens.name: easing-smooth
tokens.usage: SwiftUI .smooth. Sheets, fades, layout changes.

tokens.name: easing-bouncy
tokens.usage: SwiftUI .bouncy. Only the success moment.
